# Tow-botic Systems — Towbot

## Company
Tow-botic Systems is a marine-technology product company developing Towbot, a configurable family of detachable battery-electric manoeuvring units. The company operates from India and the Netherlands.

## Product
Towbot is a detachable battery-electric thruster platform for ship manoeuvring, barge positioning and temporary dynamic positioning. It attaches temporarily to a compatible vessel or floating asset using an application-specific hull interface, without permanent propulsion conversion.

## Product Range
- TB120: 120 kW class. Lead platform. Inland barges, pontoons and sheltered-water manoeuvring.
- TB340: 340 kW class. Configurable platform. Work barges, marine construction and temporary positioning.
- TB1400+: 1.4 MW+ class. Engineered to order. Heavy floating assets, high-thrust ship-assist and multi-unit port operations.

## Applications
- Ship manoeuvring: berthing, unberthing, lock transits and confined-port operations.
- Barge positioning: portable propulsion and positioning for barges, pontoons and work platforms.
- Portable dynamic positioning: temporary DP for marine construction, dredging, jack-up support and offshore campaigns.

## Technology
Hull attachment and load transfer, electric propulsion, battery-electric energy and charging, cameras and navigation sensors, authenticated communication, operator HMI with override and emergency stop.

## Patents
US Patent 10,604,218 B2 and UK Patent GB 2,568,328 B — remote-controllable underwater device and method for manoeuvring vessels. Inventors: Gary Vaz and Eric Holohan.
